sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Removes the banner, native, full-screen, and video ads.
Stops the app's analytics, ad measurement, and marketing services.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Signs in with Google through GmsCore instead of Google Play services.
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Removes JustWatch's own sponsored title cards and sponsored trailers before videos.
Hides Watchlist titles that are not on the services you picked. With All picked, hides titles that no service offers, except unreleased titles.
Hides movies you marked as seen and shows you are caught up on from the Watchlist.
Hides your mobile carrier from the app, or reports a carrier name you choose.
Shows only titles you can stream on a subscription or for free on the Watchlist. Titles you can only rent or buy are hidden. Picking a Types filter in the app overrides this.
